name: Spaghetti Western Simulator
summary: The player takes on the role of Clint Westband, a bounty hunter in pursuit of the desperados of the Wild West. As he makes his way through the streets, he has to take down bandits to earn more bounties, and along the way he can collect dynamite (to blow things up), extra bags of cash and keys to open doors. There are also items to collect to kill ghosts, scorpions and hornets, as they absorb his energy and eventually kill him. Be careful not to shoot innocent bystanders, or some of the bounty collected will have to be returned.
